newsitem.title: USA: PEPSICO'S PIZZA HUT SELLS 148 RESTAURANTS.
newsitem.headline: PEPSICO'S PIZZA HUT SELLS 148 RESTAURANTS.

text.p: PepsiCo's Pizza Hut Inc said Thursday it will sell 148 Pizza Huts in California, Oregon and Nevada to PacPizza LLC.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
The company said the deal, which is the largest purchase of Pizza Hut restaurants to date, makes PacPizza the second largest franchisee in the Pizza Hut system.
PacPizza LLC is a new company formed by Provender Capital Group LLC and based in New York. Pizza Hut said Provender is a minority- and women-owned merchant banking firm.
Co-investors in the deal are Scorpion Holdings Inc, and James Gressett and Michael Long of L&G Financial Holdings.
